about: The introitus of the formulary “21st Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: All things are placed within Your will, O Lord, and there is no one who can resist Your will; for You have made all things, heaven and earth, and all that is contained within the compass of heaven: You are the Lord of all things. Blessed are the spotless in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
